queriesText.title: Tracks, one per line
queriesText.description: Paste your list straight in. 'Title - Artist', 'Artist - Title', 'Title by Artist', 'Title / Artist' and tab-separated columns all work, and a leading track number such as '12. ' is ignored. A line that is already a Spotify link or URI is passed straight through without a search.

queries.title: Tracks as a list
queries.description: The same thing as an array, for callers that already hold a list rather than a blob of text.

tracks.title: Structured tracks
tracks.description: Objects with title and artist kept apart, which removes the guesswork about which side of the separator is which. Optional album and durationMs sharpen the match further - a duration within two seconds of a candidate raises its score, and one more than thirty seconds out lowers it.

minimumMatchScore.title: Minimum match score
minimumMatchScore.description: Between 0 and 1. Anything scoring below this is reported as unmatched, with its best guess attached so you can review it. Raise it towards 0.85 when a wrong URI is worse than a missing one; lower it towards 0.55 when you would rather review near-misses by hand. Spotify returns a result for literally any text, so this threshold is what stops nonsense turning into a confident answer.

emitUnmatched.title: Include unmatched rows
emitUnmatched.description: Keep a row for every input line that did not clear the threshold, carrying its best guess and why it was rejected. Turn this off for a clean matched-only output - but then a dropped line leaves no trace.

maxQueries.title: Maximum lines
maxQueries.description: Ceiling on how many lines a single run processes, so an oversized paste cannot run away. Each line costs one request.

exportFormats.title: Extra export files
exportFormats.description: Besides the dataset, write ready-made files into this run's key-value store. A plain matched-uris.txt is always written regardless of this setting.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Off by default and genuinely optional. This actor searches through Spotify's web player gateway, which has shown no request ceiling - unlike Spotify's public Web API search, which bans by IP for around twenty hours once tripped. That is exactly why the gateway is used here.
